event_description: A user successfully created an account and entered the email verification flow.
An authenticated user successfully signed in.
A user opened checkout for a selected plan and billing interval.
An authenticated browser-extension capture was accepted and queued for processing.
An extraction job reached a completed, partially completed, or failed terminal state.
A user completed a CSV import into the CRM.
A persisted export job reached a completed, partial, or failed provider outcome.
A new manual CRM contact was successfully created after deduplication.
A CRM contact owner assignment was successfully changed or cleared.
A new CRM opportunity was successfully created.
A CRM opportunity successfully moved to another stage.
A user successfully connected and validated an SMTP mailbox integration.
A user created a new automation flow draft.
A user successfully published an automation flow.
A user created a new email campaign draft.
A user successfully launched an email campaign.
A Hubble query completed; only operational metadata is captured.
A Hubble query failed; only a bounded error code and duration are captured.
A development-only synthetic browser or server delivery check completed.
